points.point: Is there an approval link I can send to the client?
points.sentence: Blotato does not have a built-in approval-link feature in the web app.

points.point: How to hold one post back for edits
points.sentence: To pause a post for edits, open the three-dot menu and choose Move to Drafts.

verdict.reason: The post-approval entry states there is no built-in approval link in the web app and gives the three-dot menu Move to Drafts step for holding a post back for edits, covering both questions.
